newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian dollar drops, bonds firm on jobs data.
newsitem.headline: Australian dollar drops, bonds firm on jobs data.

text.p: The Australian dollar dropped and bond futures firmed after the June labour force report showed a 11,900 rise in employment, weaker than median expectations.
Forecasts had centred on a 42,500 rise after May's 40,300 fall, while the unemployment rate fell to 8.5 percent from 8.8 percent and against an expected 8.7 percent rate.

The dollar fell to US$0.7410/15 compared with US$0.7439/44 just before the report, while the September 10-year bond futures contract went to 93.340 against a pre-data 93.285. Bill futures also firmed, moving to 94.95 from 94.87.
